The brain is part of an impressive collection held by a colleague in Austria and, upon learning of his wife's infidelity, the surgeon allows himself to be charmed. Communicating telepathically with one of the specimens in the laboratory, he falls in love - but needs a body to put it in.

sky cinema greats.title: So I Married an Axe Murderer
sky cinema greats.desc: A lonely poet who's unlucky in love believes he's struck gold when he meets Harriet, an attractive, witty woman who owns a butcher's shop. They fall in love and marry, but a series of strange occurrences lead him to suspect that his new wife may be harbouring a dark and deadly secret.

sky cinema greats.title: Caddyshack
sky cinema greats.desc: A rich property developer wants to take over an exclusive country club and so challenges its pompous president to a game of golf leading to utter mayhem, and a stream of surreal and crude visual gags.

sky cinema greats.title: Kindergarten Cop
sky cinema greats.desc: Comic tale in which a tough cop is forced to go undercover as a kindergarten teacher. In his new role, he must track down a mother and son who are the only witnesses against a drug-dealing criminal, who is also their husband and father. The cop uses his brutal methods to negotiate the mundane problems of child control.

sky cinema drama.title: Legends of the Fall
sky cinema drama.desc: Sweeping epic about three sons raised on a Montana ranch by their father, a colonel who has turned his back on the army after the Indian Wars. Though the destinies of the boys are very different, two forces impact on each of their lives: the Great War in Europe and the love of a young woman. Covering several decades, the action ranges from majestic Montana to the battlefields of Europe and adventure on the high seas.

sky cinema drama.title: Valentine's Day
sky cinema drama.desc: Following a group of Los Angeles' residents who try to find their way through the highs and lows of love during a single day.

sky cinema drama.title: Grease
sky cinema drama.desc: High-spirited musical set in 1950s America, in which a girl and boy who met on the beach are unexpectedly reunited at high school. She cannot understand how different he has become. Can the leather-clad, tough-talking leader of the T-Birds really be the same person? Perhaps her new friends, the Pink Ladies, can help her win back his heart?

sky cinema drama.title: The Bodyguard
sky cinema drama.desc: A Secret Service agent-turned-bodyguard finds danger and romance while protecting an entertainer from a stalker.
